meta.description: V0 scenario-generation configuration. CAUSE-layer data only -- no traffic-state values (queue, density, flow, speed, shockwave) may ever be added here.
changelog: 0.2.0: corrected route structure to the real 3-edge in->via->out chain; corrected north/south/east/west -> edge mapping using the real network directions; added normal_controller.py compatibility aliases; added an informational (unused-by-generator) signal-phase reference block pending link-index resolution.

network._movement_map_provenance: CONFIRMED from the actual network (1o->51o, 2o->52o, 3o->53o, 4o->54o intermediate structure supplied directly). The terminal-edge assignment per movement matches the prior inferred mapping exactly; the previously-missing piece was the intermediate 'via' edge, now included. Routes are generated as the full 3-edge chain [in_edge, via, out] -- a direct 2-edge path is no longer used as the default.
network._route_edge_override_note: No longer the primary routing mechanism (it was, when the real topology was unknown). Kept only as an escape hatch for future network changes: {"in_edge": {"movement": ["edge1", "edge2", ...]}} overrides the canonical movement_map chain for that specific (in_edge, movement) pair.

_approach_name_mapping_provenance: CORRECTED from real network directions (1i=WEST, 2i=EAST, 3i=SOUTH, 4i=NORTH). Previous config (v0.1.0) had this backwards (north->1i etc.), which was an unverified assumption -- flagged as such at the time. Every non-balanced approach_pattern in a scenario generated under v0.1.0 allocated demand to the wrong physical edge relative to its semantic label.

_signal_reference._purpose: INFORMATIONAL ONLY. Not read by scenario_builder.py -- the scenario generator never touches signal phases. Captured here for the future normal_controller-compatibility and ASTRID-controller work.
_signal_reference._structural_analysis: Green link groups: phase0={0,1,6,7} (4 links), phase2={2,8} (2 links), phase4={3,4,9,10} (4 links), phase6={5,11} (2 links). Consistent with a standard dual-ring layout: each opposing approach-pair gets a combined through+right phase (4 links = 2 through/right lanes x 2 approaches) then a protected-left phase (2 links = 1 left lane x 2 approaches).
_signal_reference._unresolved: RESOLVED BY CROSS-REFERENCE, NOT independently verified against raw <connection> data. normal_controller.py's own comments state phase0/phase2 = EW, phase4/phase6 = NS. Combined with the confirmed compass mapping (1i=WEST, 2i=EAST, 3i=SOUTH, 4i=NORTH), this means phase0/phase2 serve 1i+2i and phase4/phase6 serve 3i+4i. Two independent sources now agree; no <connection>/linkIndex list has been supplied to prove it directly, so treat as high-confidence rather than certain.

_controller_compatibility._purpose: normal_controller.py requires fields name, demand, demand_rate, approach_distribution (confirmed by reading its source). scenario_builder.py writes these as explicit alias fields on every scenario.json: name (= scenario_id), demand_rate (= demand_rate_veh_per_hour, the numeric value actually used in calculate_directional_demand), demand (= demand_class, e.g. 'HIGH' -- confirmed from source to be used only in a print label, never in a calculation, so a class string is correct here, not a duplicate number).
_controller_compatibility._approach_distribution_requirement: normal_controller.py requires approach_distribution to contain exactly the keys north/south/east/west summing to 1.0 (tolerance 1e-5). This project's approach_patterns already produce exactly that shape -- no change needed there.

_webster_reference._purpose: Constants mirrored from normal_controller.py, used ONLY to compute a scenario-design diagnostic (estimated Webster Y-ratio) so V0 scenario selection is grounded in the controller's own capacity model instead of an arbitrary multiplier heuristic. NOT used to alter scenario generation logic itself. Keep in sync manually if normal_controller.py's constants change.
_webster_reference._lanes_cross_check: 6.0 = 2 opposing approaches x 3 lanes_per_approach, consistent with network.lanes_per_approach=3 above.

_demand_bands_note: Multipliers of baseline total_demand_veh_per_hour=1600. Still PROVISIONAL -- unchanged by the routing/direction fix. Confirm/adjust once V0 scenarios are actually run through SUMO with correct routes.
_movement_pattern_note: V0 applies one movement_distribution identically across all four approaches. Per-approach movement heterogeneity remains a deliberately out-of-scope future extension.
